story.titleZh: 安东内利需要的是什么 - 我们对F1世界冠军的评判
story.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军，年仅20岁，仅在其第二个赛季。以下是我们对他的成就和2026年表现的看法，我们对一些批评者的回应，以及我们希望从安东内利那里看到的东西。
story.originalTitle: The rival Verstappen needs - our verdict on Antonelli's F1 title
detailZh: 基米·安东内利是F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军，年仅20岁，在赛道上的第二个赛季就实现了这一壮举。
我们来分析他的成就和他的2026年表现，我们对一些批评者的回应，以及我们希望从安东内利那里看到的东西。
不要被'统治级赛车'的叙事所影响
对于安东内利来说，他的速度潜力从未有过任何疑问，但他以很少的重大错误赢得冠军是了不起的。
除了在澳大利亚的FP3练习赛中发生碰撞并在巴库排位赛的1号弯擦到内壁之外，对于一个第二年的年轻车手来说，他已经表现得相当干净利落了。
是的，他还有一些粗糙的边缘需要打磨，正如他倾向于危险地与赛道极限擦肩而过所展现的那样。但这是他在努力改进的地方，奥斯汀也展现了他正在取得进步。随着他整理这些游戏中的方面，并将其与他的基础速度以及他在比赛中展现出的几乎像费尔南多·阿隆索一样的坚持不懈结合起来，他将变得越来越强大。
这就是安东内利成就的非凡之处。他离一个经验更丰富的车手还有很长的路要走，但即使在这个未完善的形式下，他的表现也相当出色。
不要被一些人关于梅赛德斯压倒性统治的叙述所迷惑。
是的，这确实是最全面的强大组合，但队友乔治·拉塞尔的困境证明，从中获得最佳效果并适应新规则并不容易。而且安东内利在默认驾驶风格上可能比拉塞尔有优势的情况下，投入了大量的工作来做这件事。
维斯塔潘终于有了潜在的对手
感觉自从2020年代初以来，马克斯·维斯塔潘一直是F1的标杆车手；特别是，一旦他在2021年击败了刘易斯·汉密尔顿，感觉就像是标杆车手之间的真正更迭。
在地面效应时代，没有人能接近挑战维斯塔潘成为年度最佳车手的称号；甚至去年，维斯塔潘也高于世界冠军兰多·诺里斯。
但是，最终，2026年给了我们一个能够在安东内利身上挑战这一点的车手。安东内利像维斯塔潘一样速度惊人，但说他还超越了维斯塔潘成为F1的标杆车手还为时过早，他当然可以挑战他成为2026年的标杆车手。
我们现在所能希望的只是安东内利和维斯塔潘明年能有可比拟的冠军挑战者级别的赛车。
我们知道安东内利已经超越了拉塞尔，就像维斯塔潘对抗汉密尔顿一样——而汉密尔顿曾对抗过阿隆索，阿隆索又曾对抗过迈克尔·舒马赫——安东内利在相似的赛车中对阵维斯塔潘将告诉我们他将成为多么伟大的F1车手。
安东内利是一位令人印象深刻的、当之无愧的冠军，他在第二个赛季中取得了惊人的进步，让包括梅赛德斯在内的所有人都感到惊讶。
我看到了一些关于他竞选活动的侮辱性评论，因为全新的规则和愚蠢复杂的引擎改变了过去的排名。这种暗示是安东内利的赛季不如以前那么令人印象深刻，因为这些车...比以前更差吗？这些车必须以某种方式驾驶，引擎会做奇怪的事情，等等。
这些陈述中确实有真相。但这是怎么成为对安东内利的指责呢？拉塞尔也有同样的机会，但并没有发生。这并不适用于大多数车手，大多数赛季。维斯塔潘在2023年不可思议的好赛季并没有因为整个赛季没有人接近红牛车队而受到影响——这个冠军和其他冠军一样重要。
我承认，这确实让人对安东内利在不同规则下重复这一壮举的能力产生了一些疑问。但即使如此，他也不需要这个冠军仍然受到尊重！他得到了机会，并且出色地完成了任务。这个冠军是他凭借实力赢得的。
他是否会赢得更多？如果他做到了，随着规则的改变，他将消除任何人可能想要对2026年提出的任何假设性的问题。如果他做不到，他总会有一座冠军奖杯，这足以提供足够的安慰。
在安东内利身上，我们有一位非常值得尊敬的一级方程式赛车冠军，在这个赛季还剩下四场比赛的情况下，他现在可以尽情享受成为自1953年阿尔贝托·阿斯卡里以来第一位赢得一级方程式赛车冠军的意大利人。而且，他仅仅20岁就成为有史以来最年轻的一级方程式赛车冠军，这也表明现在这已经更像是一个游戏机冠军了。
尽管如此，看到汉密尔顿取得了出色的杆位，这是他的第105个杆位，而且41岁的他成为自1982年马里奥·安德雷蒂在蒙扎（巧合的是，也是在法拉利上）以来最年长的杆位得主，这仅仅表明，只要你能利用它，经验永远不会浪费。
基米实际上主宰了整个赛季。是的，这里那里有一些小错误，但他在一致性方面无人能及。
实际上，你只能与你的队友进行比较。他们驾驶着同一辆赛车，遵循着相同的团队理念，在与拉塞尔的对抗中，他已经证明了他真正理解自己为什么能站在那里。
他明年能再次做到吗？我迫不及待地想看看结果会怎样。
我忍不住为拉塞尔感到难过。
这是安东内利应得的冠军——没有例外。他表现得非常出色。如果我不知道安东内利不可避免地会收到多少赞誉，我就不会提出这个替代话题。但他确实收到了，所以我可以。
这本来应该是拉塞尔为之努力并投入了大量努力的一年。如果规则能将车手们考验到极致，而拉塞尔最终脱颖而出，我并不介意，但他们并没有这样做。
这意味着我没有得到一场真正的、正规的拉塞尔/安东内利对决，这场对决是在考验车手而不是电池的机器上进行的。
我们可能要等到2030年才能看到那样的对决。在那之前，马克斯可能会赢得接下来的所有冠军！
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli is Formula 1's youngest-ever world champion, aged just 20 and in only his second season on the grid.
Here's what we make of his achievement and his 2026 performance, our ripostes to some of his critics, and what we're hoping to see from Antonelli next.
Don't be swayed by the 'dominant car' narrative
There was never any doubt about Antonelli's pace potential, but for him to win the championship with few major errors is remarkable.
Aside from crashing in FP3 in Australia and clipping the inside wall at Turn 1 in Baku qualifying, he's been remarkably clean for a young driver in only his second season.

Yes, there are still rough edges to smooth out, as exhibited by his tendency to flirt dangerously with track limits. But that's something he's working on, and Austin showed he's making progress. And as he tidies up these aspects of his game and bolts it on to his underlying pace and the almost Fernando Alonso-esque relentlessness he can show in races he will become increasingly formidable.
That's what is remarkable about Antonelli's achievement. He's nowhere near the finished article he will become with more experience, but even in this unrefined form he's performed outstandingly.
Don't be fooled by the narrative some will spin about the crushing dominance of the Mercedes.

Yes, it's been the strongest all-round package, but team-mate George Russell's struggles prove that getting the best out of it and adapting to the new regulations is not easy. And Antonelli put an enormous amount of work into doing so on top of any advantage he may have had in default driving style over Russell.
Verstappen finally has a potential equal

It felt like Max Verstappen had been F1's benchmark driver ever since the early 2020s; in particular, once he defeated Lewis Hamilton in 2021, it felt like a real changing of the guard from one benchmark driver to another.
Nobody got close to challenging Verstappen for the title of best driver of the season in the ground effect era; even last year, Verstappen was a step above world champion Lando Norris.

But, finally, 2026 has given us a driver who could challenge that in Antonelli. Antonelli is devastatingly fast like Verstappen, but while it's far too early to say he's overtaken Verstappen as F1's benchmark driver he can certainly challenge him for the status of 2026's benchmark driver.
All we can hope for now is that Antonelli and Verstappen have comparable title-challenging machinery next year.

We know Antonelli has Russell covered, so just like Verstappen going up against Hamilton - who in turn had gone up against Alonso, who in turn had gone up against Michael Schumacher - Antonelli going up against Verstappen in similar cars would tell us just how much of an F1 great he's shaping up to be.
Antonelli is an impressive, deserving champion who has made a remarkable step that's surprised everybody including Mercedes in his second season.

I've seen some derogatory commentary about his campaign, as completely new regulations and stupidly complex engines have skewed the pecking order from the past. The implication is that Antonelli's season is less impressive because these cars are...worse, than before? That the cars have to be driven a certain way, the engines do weird things, and so on.

There's truth in those statements individually. But how can this be held against Antonelli? Russell's had the same chance, it hasn't gone for him. It doesn't go for most drivers, most seasons. Verstappen's ridiculously good 2023 season isn't undermined by the fact nobody got near Red Bull over the course of the season - it's a title that counts as much as the rest of them.

What I will admit is it does leave a little question mark over Antonelli's capacity to repeat the feat in a different ruleset. But he doesn't need to for this title to still be respected! He got the chance, he did the job brilliantly. This championship is his on merit.

Will he win more? If he does, as the rules change, he will obliterate any supposed asterisks anyone may want to impose on 2026. If he doesn't, he'll always have one championship trophy that'll offer plenty of consolation.

In Antonelli we have a very worthy F1 champion, and with four races left this season he can now just enjoy being the first Italian to win the F1 championship since Alberto Ascari in 1953. Also the fact he has become the youngest ever F1 champion at just 20 years old just shows that it's now become more of a Game Boy championship.

That said, seeing Hamilton achieving a fantastic pole position, his 105th and at 41 the oldest driver to do so since Mario Andretti at Monza in 1982 (coincidently also in a Ferrari) just shows that experience, as long as you tap into it, never goes to waste.
Kimi has in reality dominated the season. Yes, there were a couple of small errors here and there, but in his consistency he has been second to none.
In reality you can only be judged against your team-mate. They drive the same car with the same team philosophy and against Russell he has shown he really understands why he is where he is.
Can he do it again next year? I can't wait to see how it all turns out.
I can't help but feel sorry for Russell.

This is a deserved championship for Antonelli - no exceptions. He's been phenomenal. And had I not known the amount of praise Antonelli will inevitably receive, I wouldn't have broached this alternative topic. But he has, so I can.

This was supposed to be the year Russell was building towards and had put in the hard-yards apprenticeship for. I wouldn't mind if the rules tested the drivers to the maximum and Russell came out on top, but they just aren't doing so.
That means I have a feeling of unfulfillment that we didn't get an actual, proper Russell/Antonelli battle in machinery that tests the drivers and not the batteries.
We'll probably have to wait for 2030 for that. And Max may well win the next championships until then!
keyPointsZh: 安东内利在仅第二个赛季中表现出色，尽管有几次小失误。
他的车手潜力一直存在，但能在没有重大错误的情况下赢得冠军是了不起的。
尽管有批评声音，但安东内利的进步和潜力不容忽视。
keyPointsEn: Antonelli has performed outstandingly in his second season, despite a few minor mistakes.
His driver potential has always been there, but winning the championship without major errors is remarkable.
Despite criticism, Antonelli's progress and potential should not be overlooked.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.

国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
